{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
trial.info()
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(trial.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (trial['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("\nNumber of unique patient_id:", trial['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(trial))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id rows:", len(trial) - trial['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (re-tested patients)
print("\nNumber of patients with multiple sample_seq (re-tested):", (trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique() > 1).sum())"}
